summary.text: Sevier White is the Libertarian Party nominee for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma, on the general-election ballot after the party's June 16, 2026, primary was canceled. He was previously the Libertarian candidate for Oklahoma's 4th Congressional District in 2016. Little else about his background is publicly documented.

paragraphs.text: White ran as the Libertarian candidate for U.S. House in Oklahoma's 4th District in 2016. In the November 8 general election he and Democrat Christina Owen lost to incumbent Rep. Tom Cole (R).
White has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
